* '''PC-E1''' ([[Krayt Dragon Howl (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 5 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1250_67">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock5Type (Virtual Block 5 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “USED: Activate 1 Force. STARTING: If Credits Will Do Fine on table, deploy from Reserve Deck Tatooine: Queen's Landing Site{{!}}Queen's Landing Site (with [Tatooine] Obi-Wan, his matching weapon, and [Virtual Block 1] Obi-wan's Cape there). When you draw your starting hand, draw five cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' “Obi-Wan's Cape” is written “Obi-wan's Cape”, with a small w. The same wording is already in the Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1250_67">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Holotable data, copy on GitHub). Card data is evidence only, not a card document.</ref>; that data is named only as evidence that the wording existed, not as a publication, and the version is dated by the card list. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. '''Document:''' a text list on the website, with no card image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Krayt Dragon Howl (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-kraytdragonhowl-pre.gif]]): “USED: Activate 1 Force. STARTING: If Credits Will Do Fine on table, deploy from Reserve Deck Tatooine: Queen's Landing Site{{!}}Queen's Landing Site (with [Tatooine] Obi-Wan, his matching weapon, and [Virtual Block 1] Obi-Wan's Cape there). When you draw your starting hand, draw five cards instead of eight. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' the card-list changes are undone: the image prints the original words of [[Krayt Dragon Howl (V)]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Date:''' placed at its server upload date, 25 February 2013, when the Players Committee server received the Virtual Block 1–7 card images. The image may have been made earlier (Players Committee card images go back to the first Legacy releases), but nothing firmer dates it, so it is placed at the upload date (Bill, 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date; what was published last counts as current). '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; slip number “67E” bottom right, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 5 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
